offering_description.value: Distributes test, measurement and calibration instruments and provides calibration, repair and asset management services for manufacturers and other industrial companies. Serves customers in life sciences, aerospace, food and beverage, utilities and manufacturing, delivering through a network of calibration labs and on-site service teams.

primary_products.value: test and measurement instruments; calibration equipment; process instruments; temperature and pressure gauges

primary_services.value: calibration; repair; asset management; equipment rental

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers and industrial plants in life sciences, aerospace, food and beverage, utilities and electronics

end_markets.value: life sciences; aerospace and defense; food and beverage; utilities; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments and calibration equipment sold to industrial customers; service fees: calibration, repair and on-site technical services; rental or leasing: instrument rental programs for customers
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys instruments from manufacturers and resells them to industrial customers; service provider: performs calibration and repair for customers' instruments at its labs or on-site

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with calibration labs and service locations in both countries

specialization.value: related lines: instrument distribution, calibration services, repair and asset management for the same industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field and inside sales teams calling on industrial accounts; own locations: company calibration laboratories and service centers; online: online catalog and e-commerce ordering for instruments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: calibration accreditation to ISO/IEC 17025 standards and quality rules for regulated customers such as pharmaceutical and aerospace makers
